items.title: 14.10 Hawa ki aaloodgi se jure mumkina sehat ke khatre (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.10, printed page 315.

blocks.text: Hawa ki aaloodgi sehat ke khase khatre rakhti hai. Mumkina asrat fauri (acute) ya purane (chronic) ho sakte hain aur pollutants ki qism aur concentration, samne ki muddat aur fard ki kamzori ke saath badalte hain. Bunyadi khatre 14.10.1 mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si chaar cheezein tay karti hain ke aaloodi hawa kisi shakhs ko kitna nuqsan deti hai?
blocks.explanation: Pollutant ki qism, us ki concentration, shakhs kitni der samne rehta hai, aur shakhs ki apni kamzori, jo bachchon, buzurgon aur dil ya phephron ke mareezon mein zyada hai.

items: Sehat ka khatra pollutant ki qism, concentration, samne ki muddat aur fard ki kamzori par munhasir hai; asrat fauri ya purane.
